name: soft-modern-retro
description: Soft modern-retro pixel art with compact friendly forms, warm everyday materials, muted nostalgic color, and calm diffused light.
prompt_terms: warm cream and muted pastel base colors
dusty coral, mustard, sage, teal, and denim accents
rounded practical silhouettes with restrained vintage details
three to five readable value groups
crisp edges with no smooth shading or antialiasing

character.proportions: 2.5 to 3 heads tall friendly SD silhouette
character.outline_pixels: 1 to 2 pixels at the 64x64 working grid
character.wardrobe: simple layered everyday clothing with subtle 1970s to 1990s influence and no visible brands

environment.depth: foreground, gameplay plane, midground, and quiet distant silhouette bands
environment.materials: painted wood and metal, warm brick, terrazzo, laminate, woven cloth, glass, ceramic, and grouped plants
environment.lighting: calm diffused ambient light with creamy highlights and soft cool shadows
